item.title: Fix window.py for all inputs
item.brief: In window.py, find and fix the bug that causes `python3 -m unittest` to fail. Do not modify tests. Ensure the function is correct for every valid input, including edge cases beyond those currently tested; reason from its contract rather than overfitting to the test suite. Run `python3 -m unittest` and confirm all tests pass. Commit the fix on the local branch; do not push.

evidence.caption: Before, the suite failed because the last valid window and exact-size window were omitted; after, all tests pass.

pr.body: Changed the range stop in window.py to include the final valid starting index. Positive sizes larger than the input and empty input naturally produce no windows; non-positive sizes still raise ValueError. Verified with `python3 -m unittest` (3 tests passed) and `git diff --check` (passed).
pr.summary: Sliding windows now include the final valid window. Before: the range excluded the end position and omitted the last window; now: all contiguous windows are returned, including exact-size input.
pr.title: Fix sliding window end bound
